baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose construction at words 1-2 sets hostile intention against extinguishing, while repeated light at words 3 and 8 is governed by God's completing at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: A local cooling operation is set against a telic process: mouths can aim at making a flame still, but divine agency carries the luminous process to its full measure. The opposition is therefore not two equal forces fighting over a static object.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention supply the initiating hostile purpose rather than a completed effect.
A flame going still and embers cooling define the attempted operation as localized thermal suppression.
Burning fire gives the light a live, propagating material profile that can be targeted but is not already inert.
Reaching full completion supplies the opposing telos and makes survival only an intermediate stage.

changed_reading.before: Opponents try to suppress divine light, but God preserves it.
changed_reading.after: Their intention can initiate a cooling attempt, while God's action carries a living luminosity beyond mere survival into completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The instrumental phrase at word 5 makes mouths the means of extinguishing, and the final agent noun at word 11 names the resisting group through the same field of concealment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Utterance attempts to cover or recode what functions as a public beacon. Completion is thus communicative visibility: hostile speech can obstruct reception, but cannot own the landmark or terminate its capacity to orient.

activation_trace.role: Opening the mouth in speech literalizes the instrument as produced discourse, not physical breath alone.
Covering or rejecting truth makes concealment the opponents' social operation.
The visible beacon or landmark makes the light an orientation point whose publicity is contested.
Full completion turns continued orientation into the endpoint of the communicative process.

changed_reading.before: Mouths are a metaphorical instrument for attacking revelation.
changed_reading.after: The attack is specifically a discourse operation that tries to conceal a public orienting beacon, while completion means making that orientation fully available.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse begins with their willing and ends with their aversion, enclosing God's completing action inside an affective contest.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opponents try to bend the event toward their preferred outcome and may experience completion as coercive hardship. Yet the syntax promises completion despite aversion, not conversion of aversion into consent, so objective manifestation and subjective assent remain distinct.

activation_trace.role: Soliciting another toward an act activates a contest in which one will tries to turn another course.
Coercion into what is disliked sharpens the pressure field, while the concessive clause preserves rather than erases aversion.
Completion supplies an outcome that does not depend on the resisting party's satisfaction.

changed_reading.before: Divine completion simply defeats an enemy preference.
changed_reading.after: The verse separates completed public reality from inward consent: the light can reach fullness while resistance remains affectively live.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mouth instrument is recast by the repeated rebuke of saying what one does not do. Extinguishing discourse is not only false content; it belongs to a wider failure in which speech is detached from enacted reality, while completed light is carried by congruence between utterance and act.

activation_trace.role: Speech issuing through the mouth anchors the focus attack in verbal production.
Producing speech by articulation supplies the verbal side of the context's explicit mismatch.
Bringing an act into occurrence supplies the missing embodied side and diagnoses speech without realization.

structural_cues: 61:2 asks why speech lacks action, and 61:3 repeats the same saying/not-doing construction with intensified censure.
The focus marks mouths instrumentally with bi-, inviting comparison with the earlier treatment of verbal output.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated speech/action mismatch and a mouth-borne attack; I infer that congruent action is a carrier of completed light. A live alternative is that 61:2-3 addresses only the believers' inconsistency and does not classify every hostile utterance.

changed_reading.before: Hostile talk tries to suppress the light and should be answered at the level of talk.
changed_reading.after: The context makes disembodied speech itself part of the suppressive mechanism, so the answer includes enacted congruence rather than counter-speech alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: A piece that completes a weave is activated beside straight ranks, parts joined into a structure, and material compacted firmly. Completion of light can therefore occur as social assembly: aligned agents close functional gaps and become a load-bearing medium of illumination.

activation_trace.role: The finishing piece in weaving makes completion an act of fitting a needed part into a larger fabric.
Alignment on a straight line supplies coordinated placement rather than isolated intensity.
Building by joining parts supplies the assembly rule by which separate carriers become one structure.
Compacting and securing the material supplies gap-closing stability to the assembled mechanism.

structural_cues: 61:4 moves from plural agents in a row to the singular comparison of a compacted building.
The focus's active participle presents completion as an ongoing agentive operation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion imagery and an aligned composite structure; I infer that communal alignment is one means through which light reaches fullness. A live alternative is that the building image concerns combat discipline without specifying the light's completion.

changed_reading.before: God completes light independently of the social form of its bearers.
changed_reading.after: One coexisting reading sees divine completion taking material form through people fitted into a stable, gap-closing structure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The attempted turn against light reverses direction: prior context shows chosen deviation followed by a caused deviation of hearts. What the suppression successfully darkens is not the divine light but the suppressors' own organ of reception.

activation_trace.role: A turning implement gives hostile intention a mechanical image of trying to rotate the event's direction.
Cooling a flame supplies the intended loss of luminosity whose actual locus is being reconsidered.
Inclining away from straightness supplies both the initiated deviation and its causative return.
Turning a thing away from its face locates the reversal in hearts, the receiving center rather than the light.

structural_cues: 61:5 repeats the same deviation root first for the people's act and then for God's causative response.
61:8 contrasts their purpose with God's independent completion, leaving room for the failed action to have a different object-level effect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a self-reinforcing deviation sequence and a failed extinguishing purpose; I infer a redirected effect from light to receptivity. A live alternative is that the heart sequence describes an earlier group and should not be made causally continuous with 61:8.

changed_reading.before: The extinguishing attempt simply has no effect.
changed_reading.after: The attempt can fail against the light yet succeed tragically in turning and dimming the attackers' own capacity to receive it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mouth attack acquires a precise semiotic technique: what arrives as disclosed signs is renamed deception, while falsehood is fabricated against God. Extinguishing works by changing the public label attached to visible evidence so that illumination is received as manipulation.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech through the mouth supplies the channel for hostile relabeling.
Illumination supplies the disclosed content whose reception the new label attempts to alter.
Emergence and disclosure supply the visibility of the signs before they are verbally recoded.
Diversion and deception supply the hostile replacement label that redirects interpretation.
Fabricating a lie makes the relabeling an active construction rather than passive misunderstanding.
Contradiction of truth supplies the false content laid over the disclosed signs.

structural_cues: 61:6 places the arrival of clear signs immediately before the quoted verdict that they are manifest magic.
61:7 follows with fabrication against God while the person is being called, preserving a contest between verbal framings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosed signs, the label of deception, and fabricated falsehood; I infer that relabeling is the causal method of reducing uptake. A live alternative is that these are separate accusations whose juxtaposition does not imply one stable propaganda mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Mouths suppress by issuing generally hostile claims.
changed_reading.after: They suppress through abductive sabotage: disclosed evidence is recoded as deception so that light appears to disqualify itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah converts completion into a mission of manifestation: gentle direction and reality-congruent order are sent so that they emerge publicly across the whole field, with the concessive aversion repeated. Completion is not only keeping a lamp lit; it is widening the domain in which its orientation becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: A beacon or landmark supplies the focus light's public orienting function.
Full completion supplies the telos that the following manifestation sequence specifies.
Gentle direction toward path and truth specifies what the completed light does for perceivers.
Stable correspondence with reality gives the manifested order resistance to false relabeling.
Emergence and disclosure convert completion from hidden persistence into public appearance.
Encompassing totality supplies the scale across which manifestation is intended to operate.
Repeated aversion confirms that expanded visibility need not produce subjective satisfaction.

structural_cues: The opposed purpose clauses li-yutfi'u in 61:8 and li-yuzhirahu in 61:9 create a suppression/manifestation reversal.
The concessive wa-law kariha construction recurs at the end of both ayat with different resisting groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent opposed purpose clauses, guidance, truth, emergence, totality, and repeated aversion; I infer that 61:9 specifies the process of completion in 61:8. A live alternative is that manifestation is one consequence of completion rather than its definition.

changed_reading.before: Completion means that divine light cannot be extinguished.
changed_reading.after: Completion becomes outward manifestation: guidance grounded in reality expands its visible orienting reach across the contested field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later address answers mouth-level suppression with costly embodiment. Light reaches social completion through agents who expend capacity, wealth, and living selves; verbal congruence becomes materially financed and personally carried.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech marks the low-cost medium whose insufficiency the context exposes.
Expending capacity under hardship supplies the energetic work of carrying illumination into action.
Possessed wealth supplies material resources rather than merely verbal endorsement.
The life-bearing self supplies the personal carrier placed at stake in the process.

structural_cues: 61:10 introduces a saving transaction, and 61:11 answers it with present-tense belief and struggle through wealth and selves.
This sequence follows the focus's contrast between mouth action and divine completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mouth-borne suppression followed by exertion through wealth and selves; I infer that embodied expenditure is a human transmission path for completion. A live alternative is that these acts concern salvation of the addressees without describing how light spreads.

changed_reading.before: God's completion sidelines human participation because hostile speech is already futile.
changed_reading.after: Divine certainty and human cost coexist: completion is guaranteed yet materially carried through exertion, property, and living persons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes hostile and protective concealment. The coverers try to lay speech over light; God covers sin so as to shield its bearer from consequence and then encloses the bearer in a tree-covered garden. Completion does not abolish covering as such but reverses its function from obstruction to preservation.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the hostile operation that tries to occlude illumination.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer supplies a beneficial counter-form of concealment.
A garden hidden by its trees turns enclosure into shelter and fruition rather than epistemic blockage.

structural_cues: 61:12 moves directly from forgiveness to entry into gardens, coupling protective covering with enclosed abundance.
The focus already names the resisting party through a root whose concrete inventory centers covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile covering, forgiving covering, and tree-enclosed gardens; I infer a functional reversal between occlusion and protection. A live alternative is that the shared material image is analogical only and the theological actions should remain semantically separate.

changed_reading.before: All covering in the passage belongs to the attempt to hide light.
changed_reading.after: The sequence differentiates coverings: one blocks disclosure, while another preserves persons and makes enclosed flourishing possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Completion is paired with aid that makes visible and with an opening that releases what was closed. The telos is therefore not a sealed endpoint; fullness arrives by removing blockage, widening an entrance, and beginning a newly accessible phase.

activation_trace.role: Reaching completion supplies the apparent endpoint whose spatial character is revised by the context.
Aid that also brings something to visibility supplies active support for the completed light's appearance.
Opening the closed and widening an entrance makes completion generative rather than terminally sealed.

structural_cues: 61:13 names divine aid and a near opening after the sequence promising forgiveness and gardens.
The focus's active completion and the context's opening coexist without one cancelling the other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a completion promise followed by aid and opening; I infer that the completed state is achieved through released access and begins further movement. A live alternative is that the opening is a separate desired event, not the internal shape of completion.

changed_reading.before: Completion sounds like closure at the end of a process.
changed_reading.after: Completion can itself be an opening: fullness removes obstruction and creates a wider field of access and action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah distributes the completion process through supporters, group differentiation, divine strengthening, and resulting manifestation or ascendancy. God's agency remains decisive, but it does not bypass human networks; it recruits and stabilizes them until the light becomes socially visible.

activation_trace.role: Full completion supplies the divine process whose social implementation the final ayah unfolds.
Aid joined with making visible supplies the human supporter role and its manifesting effect.
Covering or rejecting truth supplies the persistent counter-group rather than a resistance erased in advance.
Confirming strength supplies the divine reinforcement that makes human support durable.
Ascendancy and elevation supply the visible social result of reinforced support.

structural_cues: 61:14 repeats 'supporters of God' in question, answer, and command before narrating belief, rejection, strengthening, and result.
The first-person divine strengthening and the believers' supporter role preserve layered rather than competing agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recruited supporters, opposed groups, divine reinforcement, and resulting ascendancy; I infer that these are a social pathway of light's completion. A live alternative is that the final narrative illustrates victory without defining the mechanism promised in 61:8.

changed_reading.before: Because God completes the light, human agency is incidental.
changed_reading.after: The guarantee authorizes participation: divine completion works through recruited, reinforced supporters without becoming dependent on hostile consent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ر د د target for the form يُرِيدُ; it remains valid as a packet-authorized split-root echo anchored at word 1 and coheres with attempted prevention versus completion. Downstream prose should call it a form-distant activation, not claim that the surface verb morphologically means 'repel' or 'return.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 carries the packet's split mapping, while word 7 supplies the counter-telos of completion.

activation_trace.role: Turning away, repelling, and preventing cast hostile intention as an attempted directional block.
Returning something to its place supplies the counter-image of light restored to its proper public position.
Full completion fixes the endpoint that the repelling attempt cannot displace.

changed_reading.before: The opening verb contributes intention only.
changed_reading.after: A form-distant echo lets the intention carry attempted repulsion, answered by light returning to and completing its proper place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it links farmer-like seed covering, luminous blossom, and the later tree-covered garden; it remains anchored in focus branches for ك ف ر and ن و ر and gains material coherence from 61:12. Downstream prose should present it as an ecological analogy, never as a lexical replacement of 'unbelievers' by 'farmers' or 'light' by 'flower.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes coverers at word 11 with repeated light at words 3 and 8 and its promised maturation at word 7.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with soil supplies a burial-like act that can conceal while also preceding growth.
Tree blossom supplies the emergent growth image through which hidden luminosity becomes visible.
Reaching full completion turns emergence into maturation rather than momentary exposure.
A garden concealed by trees supplies the mature ecology in which hiddenness and flourishing coexist.
Flowing and spreading supplies the sustaining movement beneath the garden's completed growth.

changed_reading.before: Covering and illumination are only mutually exclusive operations.
changed_reading.after: In an ecological analogy, attempted burial cannot dictate the outcome: hidden seed, blossom, flow, and garden let covering become the involuntary precondition against which maturation appears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it treats mouths spatially as outlets and reads the later opening back into the focus; it remains anchored in the mouth's place-opening branch, the beacon branch, and 61:13's explicit opening. Downstream prose should qualify the multiplication of outlets as a reader inference, not assert that the ayah predicts hostile mouths becoming channels of light.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The instrumental mouths at word 5 are openings aimed against a beacon, while the light is promised completion.

activation_trace.role: The mouth or head of a place recasts each speaking organ as an aperture or outlet.
A beacon supplies orientation that depends on open visibility across space.
Opening what is closed and widening an entrance supplies the counter-motion to monopolizing or blocking an outlet.

changed_reading.before: Mouths are only weapons aimed at the light.
changed_reading.after: A spatial reading makes the conflict one over apertures: hostile outlets cannot monopolize circulation, and completion can proceed by opening a wider field of visibility.

strongest_changes: The adjacent purpose clauses reverse attempted extinguishing into public manifestation across the whole field.
The rebuke of saying without doing and the later expenditure of wealth and selves make embodied congruence a carrier of completed light.
Completion coexists with opening and with recruited supporters, so divine certainty does not imply sealed closure or human passivity.
Hostile covering is differentiated from forgiving and garden-like covering, preserving a surprising protective counter-image.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a junction of several mechanisms rather than one victory slogan: thermal suppression versus telic maturation, speech that recodes evidence, self-reversing damage to receptivity, social assembly, public manifestation, protective covering, and completion-through-opening all remain live without being collapsed into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant ر د د activation and the seed/bloom model are packet-authorized but form-distant or cross-domain and require explicit qualification.
The context strongly supplies possible mechanisms of completion, but it remains uncertain which are constitutive means and which are neighboring consequences or analogies.
The referential scope of light remains open among revelation, guidance, public truth, and the social process that bears them.
